notes: Reviewed unchanged: every source and target ID is partitioned exactly once (14 source, 15 target), and no head sits outside its own array.

s001 ὁ governs σφραγισάμενος with no expressed head noun, so rule 31 is out and rules 32/90 decide: one English word for the pair means the article takes the relativizer *who* and the participle keeps *sealed*. Rule 90 notes such an article will be reported as represented by a reference comparison, and that is not a correction.

t007 *us* carries ASV addition markup but is the indirect object δούς requires in English, so rule 74's object clause and rule 11 keep it inside the verb's unit rather than marking it `added`. Rule 74's `medium` hedges attach to units where an infinitive competes for the supplied word; no infinitive stands here, so this is recorded `high`.

s012/s014 divide under rule 20 proper rather than rule 76: ἡμῶν is expressed and its English is only the possessive, so it is the word *our* belongs to and ταῖς realizes nothing. Rule 76's availability test would matter only if the ASV had already spent that pronoun on some other role, as it has not.
The verse's expressed ἐν keeps *in* on itself under rule 36; the article beside it is emptied by the possessive, not by rule 21, so no bare *in the* unit arises.
